Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年09月30日13時00分25秒，於台灣地區以東海域發生5.5級地震，震源深度約為10公里，震中約位於北緯23.77度，東經122.96度，距離澳門東北偏東約977公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 30-09-2026 pelas 13:00:25 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 5.5, profundidade 10 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 977 km a leste nordeste de Macau, (23,77N, 122,96E), Região de Taiwan.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 5.5 , focal depth of 10 km, has occurred at 13:00:25 on 30 September 2026 (local time) in Taiwan Region. The epicentre is located near 23.77N, 122.96E, about 977 kilometres east northeast of Macao.
